review_scope: Scientific framing, intended difficulty, minimal necessary background, input/output boundary and fair scientific adjudication; separate agents assess workflow execution and verification correctness.
supersedes: The version-1 review incorrectly endorsed a solver-facing recipe. That endorsement is withdrawn; absence of expected answers did not make the prescribed pipeline a difficult research task.

difficulty_assessment.basis: Design-level expert review, not empirically calibrated system pass rates.
scientific_requirements: all eight elements with evidence appropriate to the question
assessment on previously unseen identified materials
qualified conclusions accounting for missing provenance
runnable analysis and auditable row-level outputs

questions.question: Q1
questions.research_objective: Determine the reliability of uncommon coordination-environment prediction and the empirical benefit or tradeoffs of imbalance treatment.
questions.required_work: Distribution audit, meaningful modeling comparison, minority-class diagnosis, material generalization and uncertainty.

questions.question: Q2
questions.research_objective: Establish where spectral distance inference becomes unreliable, including unusual environments.
questions.required_work: Regression, justified regime definitions, signed and absolute error diagnosis, material generalization and uncertainty.

questions.question: Q3
questions.research_objective: Assess incremental local-charge information beyond white-line position.
questions.required_work: A fair spectral-versus-peak predictive study, out-of-sample paired evidence, baselines and uncertainty; full spectra need not win.

questions.question: Q4
questions.research_objective: Develop a multiscale representation and test predictive utility and property-specific interpretation.
questions.required_work: Representation design, three-target comparison, physical energy mapping and validation beyond importance rankings.

questions.question: Q5
questions.research_objective: Determine which predictive and interpretive conclusions survive intensity-scale removal.
questions.required_work: A controlled normalization study, fitting/sampling sensitivity, independent localization validation and scientifically comparable stability evidence.

resolved_findings.finding: The prior protocol prescribed the solution pipeline.
resolved_findings.resolution: The solver receives only scientific objectives, relevant field definitions and a compact evidence contract; methodological recipes remain evaluator-only.

resolved_findings.finding: The checker required an exact question identifier that was absent from the standalone prompt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each prompt explicitly sets question=Q1 through Q5 in design.json.

resolved_findings.finding: Prediction scope and comparison partition semantics were underspecified.
resolved_findings.resolution: Predictions explicitly cover each test record once, and comparison_id explicitly groups shared row inclusion and partition assignments.

resolved_findings.finding: Macro-F1 averaging and irrelevant target-specific background/metrics could create unnecessary or ambiguous requirements.
resolved_findings.resolution: Coordination tasks define the three-class average and undefined-F1 convention. Background fields and metric requirements are now question-specific; unused neighbor-spread background is removed.

fair_adjudication.numerical_check_role: Source identity, labels, declared partitions, pairing and metric arithmetic; success remains scientific_review_required.
fair_adjudication.scientific_check_role: Independently rerun source and reconstruct substantive evidence; assess fairness, baselines, provenance coverage, uncertainty, interpretation and the scope of conclusions.
fair_adjudication.allowed_variation: Defensible alternative filtering, splitting, models, features, tuning, uncertainty and negative or mixed conclusions.
fair_adjudication.source_limitation: Known material IDs occur only in origin=scrape; origin=feff lacks IDs. Identified-material claims must be limited to that supported population.
fair_adjudication.interpretation_limit: Correlated feature attributions are not unique causal mechanisms; apparent stability must map to comparable features or physical energy regions.

isolation.required_boundary: Use solver-only exports and prevent access to the review repository, public site and reference artifacts.
isolation.export_contains: prompt.md plus eight gzip JSONL inputs, byte-identical to released projections.

prompt_hash_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON containing title and prompt only, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon). Full paper metadata and changing evaluator references are deliberately excluded.
execution_claim: This report does not certify execution or scientific completeness of the candidate examples; consult separately recorded execution and verification reviews.
